#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience to join our U.S.-based client's product development team. This individual will work on the client's Docs product, a multi-tenant document management system built with modern .NET and Vue.js technologies. This is an opportunity to work on a sophisticated platform that serves customers primarily in the oil and gas industry with a proven 2-week release cadence.


This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.


Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Architect Solutions: Design and implement scalable, maintainable solutions following our established patterns (Repository-Task-Controller, multi-tenancy, service-oriented design)
  • Maintain Quality: Write comprehensive unit and integration tests using NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions with 80%+ code coverage targets- own the quality of your code
  • Code Reviews: Review pull requests from team members and AI-generated code, ensuring adherence to architectural patterns and best practices
  • Collaborate on Planning: Work with the team in Azure DevOps to refine stories, estimate effort, and plan sprint deliverables have input in what you build

  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server

  • Frontend Framework Experience: Production experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular (Vue.js preferred)

  • Docker: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, local development environments, and understanding container orchestration
  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Coordenador de Operações de Marketplaces
description:
Objetivo:


Você será o dono da operação de Violação Comercial em Marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shoppe entre outros), liderando o ciclo completo de proteção comercial de grandes marcas no ambiente digital: monitoramento, identificação de sellers, diagnóstico de violação, denúncias estratégicas, comunicação de adequação e acompanhamento da regularização.



Descrição de Responsabilidades:



Operação e Governança


  • Liderar o fluxo completo de Violação Comercial em marketplaces: setup → hunting → triagem → discovery → comunicação → penalidades → acompanhamento.


  • Garantir o monitoramento contínuo de preços, SKUs e sellers em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu, Google Shopping).


  • Gerenciar processos de descoberta de sellers (CNPJ, nota fiscal, nome fantasia, múltiplos perfis).


  • Coordenar denúncias estratégicas (copyright/brand misuse) como ferramenta de identificação e adequação.


  • Pilotar a execução das trilhas de comunicação com sellers infratores até a adequação comercial.



 Relação com o Time Comercial e Canais


  • Conectar regras comerciais, PMA sugerido e diretrizes de canal com a operação prática de marketplaces.


  • Auxiliar comercial em decisões de penalidades: bloqueio de venda, corte de desconto, suspensão de canal etc.


  • Dar visibilidade dos impactos de infrações para contas estratégicas e diretoria.



Produtos, Dados e Estratégia


  • Analisar curvas de preço, reincidência e impacto por SKU, sugerindo ajustes de PMA e clusterização.


  • Mapear padrões de violação (por categoria, seller, logística, campanhas).


  • Construir dashboards de oscilação de preço e saúde de canal (base no fluxo Data Studio citado nos treinamentos → ).



Processos e Eficiência

  • Estruturar runbooks, SLAs e rituais de operação.

  • Integrar tecnologia (crawlers, priorização, bases) aos processos humanos.

  • Garantir governança documental: versões de políticas, manuais, trilhas e templates.





﻿﻿Experiência técnica obrigatória


  • Expertise em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu), BuyBox, regras automatizadas de preço, robôs de repricing.


  • Vivência com moderação e derrubada de anúncios (copyright, trademark, identidade visual).


  • Forte entendimento de políticas comerciais (PMA sugerido, canais autorizados, preço online x físico).


  • 5–10 anos de experiência com e-commerce, marketplace, pricing ou governança de canais.


  • Histórico comprovado de operação em ambientes de alta complexidade comercial.


  • Desejável vivência em projetos de proteção de marca, compliance de preço ou inteligência de mercado.



Competências de Gestão


  • Capacidade de montar e liderar time operacional.


  • Visão crítica + capacidade analítica (dados, padrões, correlação de eventos).


  • Comunicação clara, pragmática e com postura consultiva diante da diretoria.



Soft Skills


  • Perfil investigativo (curioso, conectado aos detalhes).


  • Postura firme para lidar com sellers agressivos e grandes marketplaces.


  • Visão de negócio (margem, ruptura de canal, rentabilidade, ROI).

title: Learning Experience Designer
description:
At BrainBuffet, we create fun, real-world courses that help students learn creative software and earn certifications.

We’re looking for a Learning Experience Designer  — someone who bridges education and creativity . You’ll make sure our courses don’t just teach students, but truly engage them.

This role is perfect for someone who loves to blend instructional design, storytelling, and visual creativity  — ensuring that every BrainBuffet course feels dynamic, clear, and unforgettable.

If you love spotting small details that make a big difference - from pacing and clarity to those moments where an animation or callout could make content “click” - this role is for you.

 What You’ll Do


Content Development

  • Review courses at all stages of production (pre-production, production, post-production) to ensure accuracy, clarity, engagement, and pedagogical alignment.
  • Ensure content design is grounded in evidence-based learning science, instructional strategies, accessibility, and usability principles.
  • Share thoughtful suggestions with editors, animators, designers and the Creative Director to improve pacing, flow, and visual engagement in ways that support learning outcomes.
  • Identify and address content gaps, redundancies, or inconsistencies, always considering how pedagogical connections can be strengthened for students.
  • Review written materials (lesson plans, worksheets, quizzes, and scripts) to ensure they align with learning goals and reinforce the course’s instructional design.

Creative Review

  • Watch and analyze video lessons through the student’s eyes — how can we make this click better?
  • Suggest creative ideas for editors, such as:
  • On-screen callouts to reinforce key terms
  • Animations or zoom-ins to maintain interest
  • Moments of humor, visuals, or transitions that break monotony
  • Ensure creative elements enhance, rather than distract from learning.
  • Work closely with the video and design teams to bring educational content to life — visually and conceptually.
  • Ensure creative ideas always serve the learning experience , not just the visuals.
  • Collaborate with the Learning Designer to keep BrainBuffet’s courses interactive, fun, and student-centered.

 What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Strong background in education, instructional design, or curriculum development.
  • Experience creating or reviewing digital learning content (video-based or e-learning).
  • Excellent eye for detail, pacing, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to give clear, positive, and constructive creative feedback.
  • Comfortable collaborating with multiple teams (education, editing, design).

Nice to have:

  • Background in media production or creative direction.
  • Familiarity with certification-based learning or software like Adobe, Autodesk, or Microsoft.
  • Experience balancing educational objectives with engaging, visual storytelling.

Soft Skills We Value at BrainBuffet

  • Team players  who thrive in collaborative environments and believe the best ideas come from working together.
  • People who value continuous learning and teaching , understanding that growth is a constant part of this role.
  • Respectful communicators  who listen deeply and approach feedback with empathy and clarity.
  • Individuals who work with purpose  and feel genuinely passionate about education, student success, and making learning meaningful.
  • A positive, solutions-oriented mindset — someone who can navigate challenges with creativity and calm.

If you’re passionate about making learning fun and meaningful, we’d love to meet you.

Apply now and bring your creative spark to the BrainBuffet team!


Next steps: 

Write an email to with a cover letter that elaborates why you think you are a good fit for this role. Please include your resume and any relevant portfolio you might want to share with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);

title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)


Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

title: ML/Data Science Lead
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Science Lead will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Lead will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 10 years in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.

We’re building our pipeline of vetted creative partners for near-term and future collaborations. This role is ideal for designers interested in working with BX Studio on an ad hoc project basis as opportunities align.

We’re looking for a Graphic & Motion Designer to help bring SaaS and digital-first brands to life through compelling visual and motion storytelling. You’ll collaborate with senior designers and art directors to design product-driven graphics, animations, and illustrative elements that enhance websites, pitch materials, and brand systems.

This is a hands-on creative role focused on craft, consistency, and collaboration—you’ll be designing, animating, and refining visual assets that make complex ideas feel clear, cohesive, and engaging.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and animate graphics for SaaS interfaces, abstractions, data visualizations, and infographics that communicate product stories with clarity and impact.
  • Develop brand-aligned illustrations and visual systems that extend client assets across digital experiences.
  • Design brand and sales collateral including pitch decks, social graphics, reports, and client-facing documents for both digital and print applications.
  • Storyboard and concept short animations that demonstrate product value or explain key interactions.
  • Collaborate with UX, web, and motion leads to ensure visual consistency and seamless integration across site designs.
  • Support design and production of brand collateral, pitch decks, social graphics, and internal marketing materials.
  • Translate feedback from senior designers and clients into clear creative refinements.
  • Stay current on visual, animation, and data-driven design trends, bringing fresh ideas to the team.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in graphic or motion design , ideally within an agency or digital-product setting.

  • Experience working with B2B or SaaS brands a plus.
  • Proficiency in Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (bonus: InDesign, PowerPoint, or light 3D).
  • Strong sense of composition, hierarchy, and animation timing.
  • Comfortable following established brand systems while contributing original ideas.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable in meeting deadlines across multiple projects.
  • Enthusiasm for collaboration and openness to feedback from senior team members.


Why Join BX Studio?

  • Collaborate with award-winning designers and developers on world-class Webflow and brand projects.
  • Shape high-impact visual storytelling for leading B2B and consumer technology brands.
  • Join a remote-first, high-performing team that values craft, clarity, and creative rigor.
  • Contribute to an agency recognized as the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year, helping define the next evolution of web design.

Gestão da Produção

• Garantir conformidade aos padrões de qualidade, normas internas e requisitos técnicos.

• Propor e implementar melhorias nos fluxos produtivos.

Gestão de Pessoas

• Liderar e desenvolver equipes de produção e PCP.

• Distribuir atividades, acompanhar performance e orientar tecnicamente a equipe.

• Conduzir feedbacks, treinamentos e gestão disciplinar.

• Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Produção ou função equivalente.

• Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing, melhoria contínua e ferramentas de gestão.

• Vivência sólida em chão de fábrica e gestão de equipes.

• Experiência com ERP, controle de dados e Excel.

Perfil Profissional

• Liderança prática, com forte presença no chão de fábrica.

• Organização, disciplina e orientação a resultados.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer at Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company), you will join a team of talented AI engineers to implement and deploy AI-driven solutions across various industries. You will be responsible for developing AI strategies, ensuring the successful execution of AI projects, and contribute to the development of AI tools and platforms. You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, review and implement AI solution designs, and ensure that Acora remains at the forefront of AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

AI Solution Design & Development :

  • Join teams for development and implementation of AI solutions and systems for clients across various sectors.
  • Propose a broad spectrum of different ideas to complex problems, with the ability to quickly test and iterate to identify the best performing solution
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Cloud Engineering and UI designers and developers to design scalable, cloud-based AI architectures.
  • Stay ahead of the latest AI trends and technologies to continuously improve Acora’s AI offerings.

Client Engagement & Project Delivery :

  • Work with clients to understand their business challenges and objectives, translating them into AI-driven solutions.
  • Be a team player and help to ensure the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and impact.
  • Be able to present AI strategies, solutions, and project outcomes to stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
  • Nurture client relationships, whilst building credibility and trust through consistent high-quality delivery.

Operational Excellence :

  • Be part of the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI solutions, ensuring they perform reliably at scale.
  • Develop frameworks and processes to ensure AI models are robust, explainable, and aligned with regulatory standards.


Key Skills & Experience:

  • English is a MUST.
  • Proven experience in AI/ML engineer roles, ideally in consultancy or enterprise environments.
  • Strong expertise in AI/ML algorithms, tools, and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, MCP, Azure AI Foundry, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and cloud-native AI/ML architectures.
  • Understanding of AI/ML model lifecycle management, including explainability, ethics, and fairness in AI.
  • Basic stakeholder management and client-facing experience, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to business leaders.
  • Proficiency in Python, C#, Javascript.
  • Hands-on experience with big data technologies and distributed computing is a plus.


Why Join Elastacloud?

  • Innovative Environment : Work on groundbreaking AI projects that have a real-world impact on industries such as security, finance, and energy. We pride ourselves on innovating through play and games, providing a safe environment to test many ideas and fail fast.
  • Leadership Opportunity : Shape the direction of AI innovation at Elastacloud and make a lasting impact on the business.
  • Collaborative Culture : Join a passionate and driven team that thrives on collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Professional Growth : Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities, with the chance to stay at the cutting edge of AI and cloud technologies.
