title: Analista de Automação de Processos (RPA) Pleno
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Modelo de trabalho da vaga:

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Como é ser uma pessoa Desenvolvedor de Automação de Processos (RPA):

Você irá desenvolver automação e otimização de processos operacionais na Stone. Sua missão começa por entender profundamente o estado atual ("AS IS") dos processos para, então, desenvolver o TO BE e implementar automações que visem ganho de eficiência, redução de custos e mitigação de riscos. Para atingir esses objetivos, você utilizará tanto ferramentas de código como Python e SQL quanto plataformas no/low-code UIPATH e Botcity e IA. Além disso, você será responsável por em projetos de melhoria contínua nas automações já existentes, o que inclui a realização de integrações com APIs REST. Por fim, você deverá criar e manter a documentação dos processos e códigos (PDD, UAT e SDD), seguindo as boas práticas de governança (Github, CI/CD), e contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios analíticos e dashboards sobre os indicadores operacionais.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser uma pessoa crítica e questionadora. Olhar para um processo existente sempre buscar automatizar e reduzir a necessidade de trabalho manual repetitivo, você terá espaço para isso. Porém, nos casos em que não for possível automatizar, não ter medo de botar a mão na massa e atuar na execução propriamente dita dos processos com diligência, disciplina e eficiência, garantindo a sustentação do negócio;
  • Conhecimento aplicado de ferramentas de programação Python e Botcity principalmente e ferramentas de automações tela a tela como UIPATH.
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Espírito de dono.
  • Perfil analítico. Fazer diagnósticos de causas dos problemas de forma proativa, medindo o impacto de cada uma delas no resultado do negócio, além de contribuir para construção de análises mais robustas junto aos times de dados do CSC;
  • Hands On, sem medo de resolver problemas e ter que executar processos operacionais;
  • Capacidade de ir a fundo em cada detalhe dos processos, entendendo todos os sistemas e micro etapas envolvidas.

O que aumentam suas chances:

  • Experiência prática em RPA utilizando Python, Botcity e UIPATH
  • Experiência com engenharia de Prompt/uso de IA para automação de tarefas

Nossos benefícios:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão.

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação

Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)

Horário flexível

Benefício Educação

Gympass

Auxílio Creche

PLR

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente! Caso queira saber mais:

  • Vem conhecer nosso time e aprender muito no nosso canal do Youtube.
  • Temos vários artigos no Medium.
  • Não deixe de dar uma conferida no nosso Github.
  • Confira aqui as diretrizes do nosso Código de Ética.
  • E pra ficar por dentro de todas as novidades, é só nos seguir no Twitter.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

- Experiência com geração de fluxo de caixa e provisão;

desafios de alto impacto

contato com sistemas complexos

Experiência com ERP Sankhya

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Analista de Recrutamento Júnior - Híbrido (Rio de Janeiro, Brasil)

Esta função exige um mínimo de três dias por semana de trabalho presencial em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro.

Interviews will be conducted in English

Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

Você será responsável por revisar proativamente os candidatos para determinar se eles atendem aos requisitos rigorosos e à experiência de trabalho para perfis farmacêuticos complexos, garantindo uma experiência premium, contínua e elevada para todos os candidatos e partes interessadas.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.

O Que Você Precisa Trazer

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral que refletem um profissionalismo de natureza polida.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.

O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um líder de mercado global em serviços de RH com reconhecimento da indústria.
  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.

As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.

Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature, process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.

What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Application Process Leadership: Lead candidates through the initial stages of the application process with a focus on speed, discretion, and quality.
  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

What's In It For You

  • Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities.
  • Join a company that offers a great work/life balance.
  • Join a company with proven processes and high-output technology to create efficiency.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until filled.

description:

Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em contabilidade. Experiência com

fechamento contábil, análise demonstrações financeiras, análise tributos diretos e indiretos,

análises contábeis de contas patrimoniais.

Inglês fluente.


Formação

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Assegurar processos e atividades de contas a pagar e contas a receber
  • Assegurar as conciliações contábeis completas e revisões de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.
  • Elaborar e analisar demonstrações contábeis (Balanço, DRE, DFC).
  • Controlar e contabilizar provisões, rateios e lançamentos manuais complexos.
  • Assegurar a correta classificação contábil e a aderência ao plano de contas corporativo.

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are #EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Development and integrations of payment methods -
  • Jira;
  • TeamCity;
  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;
    .
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  • Levantamento dedados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamentode novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Profissional Back End .Net/Aws - Sr
description:

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Habilidades Principais:

  • Profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento back-end .Net com sólida vivência em ambientes escaláveis (milhões de transações/requisições mensais) e arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e mensageria (RabbitMQ ou Kafka).

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Atuação híbrida;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.



Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements;
    including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services;
    ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers


Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

Desafio da Posição

Você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e evoluir o SOC , garantindo excelência em detecção, análise, resposta e contenção de incidentes de segurança. Responsabilidades

  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS/Azure/GCP).

  • Experiência com scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Threat Hunting avançado, CTI, detecção comportamental.

  • Certificações cloud (AWS Security, Azure AZ-500, Google PCSE).

About the Company

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller.   • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)

    Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage

  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.


Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.G., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.G., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.G., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.G., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.G., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

description:

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.

  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.

  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.

title: Risk Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks across the organization.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing、scenario analysis、capital adequacy evaluations and other regulatory-mandated reviews.
  • Prepare, validate, and support all regulatory disclosures required of financial institutions and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) , ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Margin-Account Risk Oversight

  • Lead the governance and oversight of margin-account operations , including:
  • Establishing risk policies for margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Defining and periodically reviewing maximum LTV ratios and haircut methodologies ;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring adherence to client and institutional exposure limits, capital buffers, and net-worth thresholds.
  • Continuously monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) across business functions, escalating breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board with clear remediation plans.
  • Operate as an independent second-line function , maintaining objectivity from commercial and trading activities while collaborating closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology.
  • Engage with internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and governance committees on matters related to risk management, capital adequacy, and prudential standards.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware culture by supporting ongoing training, communication, and enhancements to risk methodologies, models, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level experience in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within banks, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and proven capability operating as a second-line or independent control function .
  • Strong command of Central Bank of Brazil risk regulations, prudential rules, capital adequacy requirements, and VASP reporting obligations.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks , stress testing, scenario modeling, and margin-account governance involving virtual assets.

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade.

  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile).
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Day‑off de aniversário.
  • TotalPass.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

description:
Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Caixa de Assistência dos Funcionários do Banco do Brasil

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de 1944 por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população. Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País. As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família. Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O/a Gerente de Projeto atuará como responsável pela gestão do ciclo relativo à execução de projeto no Rio de Janeiro, com uma abordagem integrada relativa aos aspectos ligados a implementação e administração. Sua principal função é desenvolver o projeto de acordo com o tempo, prazo, escopo e conteúdo estabelecido junto com Cliente administrando equipe e recurso para tal escopo. Será o representante da AVSI junto a CONTRATANTE e responderá diretamente à Gerência Geral do RJ.

  1. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI;

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades.
